newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dollar purchase.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dollar purchase.

text.p: A late-hour dollar purchase by a state-owned bank forced the Bangladesh taka to finish marginally weaker at 42.8200/8300 to the U.S. currency ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, dealers said. The previous close was at 42.8000/8300.

Initial deals were done at 42.8000/8100 level but the greenback edged up later following a late purchase by the state-owned Janata Bank. "They came up with a demand for a large volume (of dollar) for import payments. That changed the scenario in an otherwise dull market," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed easier at 8.0 to 9.0 percent against a previous 9.5-10.5 percent.
